item.description:
Wallace & Gromit Shorts Collection (ORIGINAL PAL VERSIONS)
1080p BluRay REMUX AVC-NOGRP
​
This collection contains every Wallace and Gromit short in its original format - presented as it originally was in 25 frames per second. Every digital and home media release of these shorts are not presented in their original format, instead opting to slow down to 24 frames per second.

Why did I do this? Simple answer: the audio for the first three shorts were weirdly enough, "remastered" in surround, despite being produced in Mono and Stereo. The second short also had certain music cues changed from its original version, such as certain songs being replaced with copyright-free compliant alternatives (such as "Happy Birthday" being replaced with "For He's a Jolly Good Fellow"). And the fourth short, A Matter of Loaf and Death, also had weirdly fucked up-sounding audio as a result of the 24fps slowdown, leading to stretched audio.

With that in mind, I have sped up the footage through MKVtoolnix (done without re-encoding) and included the original audio for all of these shorts, including the Laserdisc PCM audio of the first three shorts, synced to the BluRay footage. This release also contains the remastered audio that was included in the BluRay for any people that prefer those versions, though the video will automatically default to the original PCM audio.

Please enjoy and share carefully.

NOTE: This collection does NOT include "The Curse of the Were-Rabbit" and "Vengeance Most Fowl", since they're full length movies and are already released in their original format.

CREDITS:​
· US Shout Factory BluRay used as a reference
· noogai3 - Original Laserdisc PCM audio for all three shorts
· iVy - Original PAL-speed BluRay audio for A Matter of Loaf and Death

2160p/4K BluRay is not used as a reference due to those masters being AI-upscaled.
